body.es:
• Estatuto del Consumidor (Ley 1480 de 2011).
• Garantía: todo producto tiene garantía legal. Si sale defectuoso, el vendedor debe repararlo, cambiarlo o devolverte el dinero.
• Derecho de retracto: si compras por internet, por teléfono o fuera del local, tienes 5 días hábiles para arrepentirte y devolverlo.
• Reversión del pago: si pagaste con tarjeta o medio electrónico y hubo fraude, no te llegó el producto o no era lo que pediste, pide la reversión en 5 días hábiles al vendedor y al banco.
• Si no te cumplen, queja ante la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).
body.en:
• Consumer Statute (Law 1480 of 2011).
• Guarantee: every product has a legal guarantee. If it's faulty, the seller must repair it, replace it or refund you.
• Right of withdrawal: if you buy online, by phone or off-premises, you have 5 working days to change your mind and return it.
• Payment reversal: if you paid by card or electronically and there was fraud, the product didn't arrive or wasn't what you ordered, ask the seller and your bank for a reversal within 5 working days.
• If they don't comply, complain to the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC).

say.es: Si compras por internet, tienes cinco días hábiles para retractarte. Si pagaste con tarjeta y hubo un problema, pide la reversión del pago. Y si no te cumplen, quéjate ante la SIC.
say.en: If you buy online, you have five working days to change your mind. If you paid by card and there was a problem, ask for a payment reversal. And if they don't comply, complain to the SIC.
